new_promises.statement: Expect to add 15 to 17 million new customers in FY27.
new_promises.quote: we continue to be confident of adding 15 - 17 million new customers in FY27.
new_promises.speaker: Rajeev Jain

new_promises.statement: Expect AUM growth of 20% to 24% in FY27.
new_promises.quote: we're confident of a 20% to 24% AUM growth, aided by new businesses
new_promises.speaker: Rajeev Jain

new_promises.statement: Expect ROA to be 4.4% to 4.6% in FY27.
new_promises.quote: We continue to guide for 4.4% to 4.6%.
new_promises.speaker: Rajeev Jain

new_promises.statement: Expect ROE to be 19% to 20% in FY27.

new_promises.speaker: Rajeev Jain

new_promises.statement: Expect full year credit cost to AUM to be 1.45% to 1.60% in FY27.
